threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's odd when someone in a cafe asks for your name before handing over a coffee. Welcome to the barista culture!
Caught the N35 last night; three lads were arguing over who could name the most obscure South London park. Only in Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I found a cat lounging on my balcony, completely unbothered, and realized it belonged to my neighbor who’d always feed strays on our street.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you sip a club mate on the street while a DJ spins vinyl from a pop-up sound system at 3 AM. It's a vibe you won't find anywhere else.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they know to avoid the 24th Street bus during rush hour—yet still hop on for the free wi-fi.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading passengers at the Civic Center station, entire bus stop clapped as the Muni pulled away. Just another day, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals hit the bars after 10 PM. Most of us have our dinner by then and are tucked in by midnight, not dancing till dawn.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They'll be the ones struggling with the ‘pato’ accent while confidently ordering in English at the boqueria.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still checking Google Maps for the bus routes. The locals know the best ones are always just a 5-minute walk away.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Peckham. A guy serenaded the driver with an off-key version of 'Wonderwall' while two pigeons squabbled over a chip. Only in London.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy jogging with his dog in a full business suit, holding a coffee in one hand and a yoga mat under the other. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you order a currywurst at 3 AM from a food stand surrounded by techno beats and random street art—perfect late-night fuel.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they casually talk about the time BART was down for a week. A fresh-off-the-plane techie just wonders why the train's late.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo getting on the 19 Polk. Looked like he just left a wedding and headed straight to a block party. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss that the real magic of Gràcia isn’t in Park Güell, but in the small plazas where locals sip vermut on a Sunday afternoon.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they enthusiastically order their coffee in English, oblivious to the locals who just nod knowingly.
